press_references.value: Dubai startup launches AI-powered cloud gaming platform

product_launches.description: The Game Company, a Dubai-based startup, officially launched its AI-powered cloud gaming platform at Dubai AI Week. The platform offers access to over 1,300 AAA titles via the cloud, features custom AI architecture for optimized performance, and is designed for seamless, low-latency gaming across devices. The launch aligns with Dubai's national strategy to become a global leader in gaming and technology.

overview_description.description:
The Game Company is a Dubai-based gaming technology company founded in 2022. The company focuses on combining artificial intelligence, cloud gaming, and Web3 technologies to create a platform where players can instantly stream and play games from the cloud.

Its platform allows gamers to access modern PC and console titles on low-spec devices such as smartphones, tablets, or laptops by streaming gameplay from remote servers. This removes the need for high-end gaming hardware and large downloads.
